answer: Sybil resistance via the tundra rule: rewards vest glacially, fraud freezes them. New identities' earnings vest over 120 epochs; fraud findings cancel unvested value. Running k puppets means advancing their costs for the whole vesting window, a cost charged k times with no batching discount, while honest agents pay once. The binding variable is the per-registration vesting clock, unresettable in parallel: re-registering restarts vesting and forfeits old unvested value, so prefarming fails. Vesting is protocol-side, the honest agent's haven; sybil balances stay hollow.
